messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for AI without making unsupported claims?

已查到可引用的部分資料：

### Short answer
To compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for AI without unsupported claims, we need a directly comparable evidence package: formal R&S product specifications/options, official competitor specifications or third-party evidence, and a dated AI use-case/test-need source that ties the solution to that AI context; the current AI server mapping is only sales/test mapping and not a formal product configuration or verified opportunity, and current competitor pages are sales positioning rather than binding specifications.[1][7][10][51]
### Required evidence
| Evidence required | Why it is required | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| A dated AI use-case or AI-market test requirement that states what is being tested, such as DUT, interface, band, protocol, production/R&D phase, measurement target, and pass/fail criteria. | The AI server ecosystem source only maps R&S instruments to AI server supply-chain categories and does not provide formal measurement conditions or formal product configurations.[1][2][51] | Current AI mapping lists examples such as ZNL/MXO/ZISO/FSWP/ZNA for server motherboard/PCBA and ZNA/ZNB for PCB IL/TDR, but it is not a formal datasheet, application note, configuration guide, or ordering guide.[6][51] |
| Formal R&S Signaling Tester evidence for the exact product and options being claimed. | CMX500 formal evidence is split between Specifications Version 11.00 and Features/Functions Version 32, and the features document is not a technical specifications datasheet.[65] | CMX500 is documented as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution supporting LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD.[13][14] |
| R&S CMX500 option evidence when claiming specific signaling capabilities. | Signaling capabilities must be tied to option codes and documented scope, such as WLAN signaling options and NR/LTE signaling options.[67][68] | The knowledge base lists CMX500 WLAN signaling option codes and NR signaling option codes, including Rel. 17 RedCap, Rel. 17 NTN, Rel. 18 NTN, Rel. 19 NTN, and NB-NTN signaling options.[67][68] |
| Formal R&S Non-signaling / production tester evidence for the exact product, configuration, and specifications. | CMP180 Features and Functions is only a test applications overview, and measurement ranges/tolerance limits must be checked in the CMP180 specifications document PD 3609.7348.22.[33][34][35] | CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00 provides binding specifications, base unit order number, RF unit order number, RF generator/analyzer specifications, ordering information, warranty, and service details.[38] |
| R&S CMP180 option/configuration evidence when claiming production or non-signaling capability. | CMP180 supports production/nonsignaling/TX/RX application options, but option codes and availability must be cited from the formal documents.[35][91][96] | CMP180 measurement options include WLAN, LTE, NR FR1 single carrier, NR FR1 multicarrier, NR FR1 MIMO, Bluetooth, UWB, NB-IoT, LP-IoT, GSM, WCDMA, and other listed options.[91] |
| Test-condition evidence for any measured performance claim. | CMP180 specifications define product-data conditions such as 3 hours ambient temperature storage, 30 minutes warm-up, specified environmental conditions, calibration interval adherence, and internal automatic adjustments.[95] | Claims without tolerance limits are not binding in CMP180 Features and Functions and must be verified against the specifications document.[34][35] |
| Competitor official documentation or third-party evidence for every competitor capability, limitation, or advantage claim. | The Anritsu comparison page says R&S battle-card claims are mainly from an internal battle card and should be checked against Anritsu official data and third-party evidence for customer documents.[9] | The Amarisoft comparison page says claims about Amarisoft currently come from a single R&S internal battle card and should be checked against Amarisoft official data and third-party evidence for customer documents.[11] |
| Separation between sales positioning and binding technical specifications. | The R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu page is sales positioning, not binding technical specifications.[7] | The R&S CMX500 vs Amarisoft page is sales positioning, not binding technical specifications.[10] |
| Competitor configuration evidence under the same test scope as R&S. | Anritsu MX844030PC official brochure evidence can describe Anritsu MX844030PC, MD8190A, and Virtual Signalling Tester, but it cannot verify R&S advantages for CMX500.[9] | The Anritsu Virtual Signalling Tester is described as a PC-based software protocol simulator for NR/RedCap protocol testing, with MAC-IF, PHY-IF/Digital-IQ, and RF-IF configurations, and RF-IF uses MD8190A and MX819020A.[25][26][81] |
| Evidence that the comparison is for the same lifecycle phase, such as R&D, conformance, manufacturing, production, or service. | The 5G device testing value chain distinguishes RF, Signaling, Application testing, OTA, Pre-conformance, Conformance approval, Carrier acceptance, Non-signaling RF, Signaling Protocol, and Service and repair.[40] | Manufacturing goals include high yield, shortest possible test time, RF transceiver characterization/optimization, debug, and trace; manufacturing/production tools listed include CMP180, CMP200, CMW100, CMX500/CMW500 for signaling, and CMQ.[42] |
| Evidence for any “AI customer,” “AI adoption,” or “AI competitor win/loss” statement. | Company names and R&S solutions appearing in the AI mapping do not mean the company purchased, evaluated, cooperated with, deployed, was visited by, or is an R&S customer.[51] | The AI mapping source does not specify whether the company list is a complete market list, R&S prospect list, customer list, investment watchlist, or internal sales focus.[5] |
### What cannot be claimed from the current passages alone
Current passages do not support a binding technical comparison that says our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution is better than a competitor for AI, because the AI evidence is only sales mapping and the competitor evidence is sales positioning unless backed by formal specs or official competitor/third-party sources.[1][7][9][10][11][51]
Current passages do not support treating the AI server mapping as a formal test configuration, quotation basis, application note, configuration guide, or ordering guide.[51]
Current passages do not support customer-relationship claims from the AI mapping, because company names and solution names in the same row do not prove purchase, evaluation, cooperation, deployment, visit history, or customer status.[51]

passages.text:
AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping
[[AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping]] 是用來保存 [[AISeverEcosystem]] 中 AI server ecosystem 分類與 [[R&S Solution]] 欄位對應關係的概念頁；它只表示該 Excel 表中的銷售 / 測試方案線索，不代表正式產品配置、客戶關係或已驗證商機。

AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping › 與既有知識的關係
- [[R&S PCB test solutions]] 提供 2026.3.4 R&S high-speed digital 簡報中的 PCB fabricator / system house 測試流程；本頁則來自市場 Excel，將 R&S 儀器與 AI server supply-chain 類別做銷售 mapping。
- [[高頻高速 PCB 測試解決方案]] 與 [[Dk-Df]]、[[Delta-L]]、[[TDR 阻抗測量]] 已有 Keysight / PCB test 圖像來源；本頁新增 R&S 方案對應，但未提供可替代正式規格的量測條件。
- [[AI 伺服器 PCB 供應鏈升級]] 記錄材料與板層升級；本頁只補充對應測試入口，例如 IL、TDR、high speed trace、PDN Target Z。
- [[資料中心電力電子生態系]]、[[NVIDIA 800V HVDC 架構]] 與 [[AI 資料中心高壓直流供電]] 記錄 data center power electronics；本頁補充 [[MXO]]、[[R&S FSWP]]、[[ZISO]] 與 BMS test 的 sales mapping 線索。

AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping › 來源中的 mapping
| 分類 | 對象 / 企業欄 | 來源中的 R&S Solution | 來源日期 / 期間 | 限制 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [[IC]] / 矽智財 / 製程 | [[智原]] | [[R&S ZNA]] + [[R&S ZNA67EXT]]、[[R&S FSWP]] | 來源未標示正式日期；raw converted 2026-09-17 | 未說明量測對象是 SerDes、jitter、phase noise、probe station 或 wafer / package |
| [[測試介面]] | [[旺矽]] | [[R&S ZNA67EXT]] | 來源未標示正式日期；raw converted 2026-09-17 | 未說明 probe card / socket / fixture / frequency range |
| 高速傳輸 IC | [[譜瑞-KY]] | [[R&S ZNA]] + [[R&S FSWP]] | 來源未標示正式日期；raw converted 2026-09-17 | 未說明高速傳輸 IC 類型、SerDes 速率或測試項目 |

AISeverEcosystem › 與既有知識的關係
- [[AI Server 供應鏈總覽]] 已整理 AI server 從 demand、compute、ODM、networking、PCB/interconnect、power、cooling 到 infrastructure 的八段式供應鏈；本來源新增更偏台股 / customer targeting / R&S solution mapping 的 Excel 表格視角。
- [[AI 資料中心生態系]] 已整理多張 AI data center ecosystem / industrial chain 圖；本來源提供更細的 server rack 零組件與 IC 分類，但來源未標示日期，不能直接更新為市場現況。
- [[臺灣 AI 伺服器供應鏈]] 依 TAITRA 2024/4 圖整理上中下游；本來源與其在 [[台光電]]、[[台燿]]、[[聯茂]]、[[欣興]]、[[南電]]、[[景碩]]、[[鴻海]]、[[廣達]]、[[緯創]]、[[英業達]]、[[台達電]]、[[光寶科]]、[[康舒]]、[[建準]]、[[川湖]]、[[勤誠]]等列名上高度相鄰，但本來源另加入 R&S solution 欄。

### Short answer
To compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for AI without unsupported claims, we need a directly comparable evidence package: formal R&S product specifications/options, official competitor specifications or third-party evidence, and a dated AI use-case/test-need source that ties the solution to that AI context; the current AI server mapping is only sales/test mapping and not a formal product configuration or verified opportunity, and current competitor pages are sales positioning rather than binding specifications.[1][7][10][51]
### Required evidence
| Evidence required | Why it is required | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| A dated AI use-case or AI-market test requirement that states what is being tested, such as DUT, interface, band, protocol, production/R&D phase, measurement target, and pass/fail criteria. | The AI server ecosystem source only maps R&S instruments to AI server supply-chain categories and does not provide formal measurement conditions or formal product configurations.[1][2][51] | Current AI mapping lists examples such as ZNL/MXO/ZISO/FSWP/ZNA for server motherboard/PCBA and ZNA/ZNB for PCB IL/TDR, but it is not a formal datasheet, application note, configuration guide, or ordering guide.[6][51] |
| Formal R&S Signaling Tester evidence for the exact product and options being claimed. | CMX500 formal evidence is split between Specifications Version 11.00 and Features/Functions Version 32, and the features document is not a technical specifications datasheet.[65] | CMX500 is documented as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution supporting LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD.[13][14] |
| R&S CMX500 option evidence when claiming specific signaling capabilities. | Signaling capabilities must be tied to option codes and documented scope, such as WLAN signaling options and NR/LTE signaling options.[67][68] | The knowledge base lists CMX500 WLAN signaling option codes and NR signaling option codes, including Rel. 17 RedCap, Rel. 17 NTN, Rel. 18 NTN, Rel. 19 NTN, and NB-NTN signaling options.[67][68] |
| Formal R&S Non-signaling / production tester evidence for the exact product, configuration, and specifications. | CMP180 Features and Functions is only a test applications overview, and measurement ranges/tolerance limits must be checked in the CMP180 specifications document PD 3609.7348.22.[33][34][35] | CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00 provides binding specifications, base unit order number, RF unit order number, RF generator/analyzer specifications, ordering information, warranty, and service details.[38] |
| R&S CMP180 option/configuration evidence when claiming production or non-signaling capability. | CMP180 supports production/nonsignaling/TX/RX application options, but option codes and availability must be cited from the formal documents.[35][91][96] | CMP180 measurement options include WLAN, LTE, NR FR1 single carrier, NR FR1 multicarrier, NR FR1 MIMO, Bluetooth, UWB, NB-IoT, LP-IoT, GSM, WCDMA, and other listed options.[91] |
| Test-condition evidence for any measured performance claim. | CMP180 specifications define product-data conditions such as 3 hours ambient temperature storage, 30 minutes warm-up, specified environmental conditions, calibration interval adherence, and internal automatic adjustments.[95] | Claims without tolerance limits are not binding in CMP180 Features and Functions and must be verified against the specifications document.[34][35] |
| Competitor official documentation or third-party evidence for every competitor capability, limitation, or advantage claim. | The Anritsu comparison page says R&S battle-card claims are mainly from an internal battle card and should be checked against Anritsu official data and third-party evidence for customer documents.[9] | The Amarisoft comparison page says claims about Amarisoft currently come from a single R&S internal battle card and should be checked against Amarisoft official data and third-party evidence for customer documents.[11] |
